name: Hyori Mika
bio: Hyori Mika is an Indonesian rising actress. She makes her feature film acting debut as the character Julia in the drama film Desember Jani (Jani Be Good), directed by Ariani Darmawan and produced by Palari Films.

credits.title: Dancing With My Shadow
credits.overview: A quiet teenager, still grieving the loss of his father, finds an unexpected friendship when he joins his high school's "Ultras" group as a photographer.

credits.title: Jani Be Good
credits.overview: Ten days after her sister Julia leaves home without a word, Jani (13) wants only one thing: her return. Jani knows her mother, Winnie, is the reason Julia left, and the two are growing distant while Winnie buries her guilt in work. Only Oma, the grandmother, comforts Jani.
